board: Montana Board of Public Accountants (Department of Labor and Industry)

cycle.note: Montana licenses renew every year by December 31. CPE: 120 hours over the three calendar years ending this December 31, at least 60 technical and 2 of ethics. No yearly minimum.

requirements.label: Three-year total
requirements.note: 120 hours in the three calendar years ending December 31 (ARM 24.201.2106). Each hour counts in every three-year window it falls in.

requirements.label: Technical
requirements.note: At least half (60 of 120) in technical subjects. Ethics counts as technical.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: 2 hours of ethics in the three years. No Montana-specific course is required.

newLicensee.note: Licensed this year: nothing is due this year. Your first 120 hours are due December 31 of the third year after the year you were licensed (courses from the year licensed don't count).

licenseDateHint: Montana licenses renew every year by December 31.
issueDateHint: New licensees: the first 120 hours cover the three full calendar years after the year licensed.
limitsNotTracked: Self-study from sponsors not on the NASBA Registry earns half credit; their nano-learning earns none.
Instructor and technical reviewer credit: each max 60 hours; report reviewer: max 16 a year; publications: max 30 hours.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for at least 5 years. Audits go through the NASBA CPE Audit Service.
toVerify: Window: the three calendar years ending December 31 of the renewal year.
Technical = NASBA technical fields plus all ethics.
